name: Café
description: Coffee and capsule shop theme ordered by the customer's coffee maker: toasted notice strip, a two-floor header with the brand, text sections and a dark rail of coffee makers, borderless cards with a full-width compatibility ribbon, an intensity scale and the price per unit, a full-width listing with a summary box and filters in a row, a product page with a tasting sheet under the gallery and a footer on coffee ink.

font_stacks.roast: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, 'Book Antiqua', 'Source Serif Pro', Georgia, serif

home_kicker.label: Line above the home page title

home_makers.label: Show the coffee maker row on the home page

strip_text.label: Notices of the strip, separated by |

rail_show.label: Show the coffee maker rail under the header

card_scale.label: Show the intensity scale in product cards

unit_price_show.label: Show the price per unit or per kilo

card_add.label: Add to the cart from product cards

system_attr.label: Code of the coffee maker attribute (empty: found by its name)
